2608.18677.title: Sanyu Studio: A Multi-Agent System for Art-Historical Narrative Construction
2608.18677.paper_summary: Amid concerns that generative AI may standardize art interpretation, this paper examines whether LLM-based interaction can support plural art-historical narrative construction. We present Sanyu Studio, a multi-agent dialogue system that models 321 Sanyu oil paintings as agents with fact, interpretation, organization, and memory-filtering mechanisms. Based on a seven-day workshop with eight art-university participants, the study shows that user prompts, evidence organization, and cognitive tendencies shaped divergent yet coherent versions of digital Sanyu. The findings suggest that, under conditions of limited historical evidence, AI can amplify human agency and offer public audiences an interactive entry point into art-historical interpretation.
2608.18677.paper_summary_zh: 在對生成式 AI 可能標準化藝術詮釋的擔憂中，本文探討基於 LLM 的互動是否能支持多元的藝術歷史敘事建構。<lb/>我們介紹了 Sanyu Studio，一個多代理對話系統，將 321 幅 Sanyu 油畫建模為具有事實、詮釋、組織和記憶過濾機制的代理。<lb/>基於與八位藝術大學參與者進行的為期七天的工作坊，研究顯示用戶提示、證據組織和認知傾向塑造了數位 Sanyu 的不同卻一致的版本。<lb/>研究結果表明，在有限歷史證據的條件下，AI 可以增強人類的主動性，並為公眾提供一個互動的藝術歷史詮釋進入點。
